exam.exam_name: Central Bank of India Counsellor (FLCC / RSETI) & Specialist Officer Recruitment
exam.conducting_body: Central Bank of India, Corporate Office Mumbai
aliases: Central Bank of India Financial Literacy Counsellor Exam

source_evidence.captured_wording: Affix recent passport size photograph on the application form and upload scanned image (20 KB - 50 KB) on portal.
source_evidence.document_title: Engagement of Counsellors for FLCCs and Directors for RSETIs on Contractual Basis

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.
dimensions.permitted_pixel_range: 200 x 230 px; 20 KB to 50 KB JPG

requirements.content_instructions: JPG, JPEG; 200 x 230 px; 20 KB to 50 KB JPG; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; Light/white background; Clear frontal portrait

requirements.requirement_name: Bank Retirement / Experience Proof (PPO / Service Certificate)
requirements.content_instructions: PDF; 100 KB to 500 KB PDF scan; A4 original document; Mandatory prerequisite for FLCC Counsellor / RSETI Director: Candidate must be a retired officer of a Public Sector Bank, RRB, or Private Bank with at least 20 years of service, having retired as Scale II or above

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Engagement of Counsellors for FLCCs and Directors for RSETIs on Contractual Basis - Section 5 (Application Modalities) (https://www.centralbankofindia.co.in/sites/default/files/Counsellor_Advt_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Engagement of Counsellors for FLCCs and Directors for RSETIs on Contractual Basis - Section 5 (Application Modalities) (https://www.centralbankofindia.co.in/sites/default/files/Counsellor_Advt_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
